name: Shimizu Ritual
source:
Ayaka Nakamura, a respected student at school, harbors a dark secret as she secretly bullies Emi Shimizu, a girl who is interested in the Occult. One day, in what seemed like a normal day for Emi, she summons a devil that can grant her any wish. What will she wish for? Will it be revenge, or something else?

[From [url=https://maple0.itch.io/shimizu-ritual]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
中村绫香是学校里一位受人尊敬的学生，她隐藏着一个黑暗的秘密，因为她暗中欺负对神秘学感兴趣的女孩清水惠美。有一天，对惠美来说看似平常的一天，她召唤了一个可以实现她任何愿望的恶魔。她会许什么愿望呢？是报复，还是别的什么？

[来自[url=https://maple0.itch.io/shimizu-ritual]itch.io[/url]]
